description: Mutually exclusive predictions from Cube 4 native-depth selector and a globally relabelled quarter-selector rival, both using the same selected-output one-dash-per-physical-column condition.

construction.parent_family: 324 completions: raw primary one-minority-per-physical-column and Q4 one slash per A-I depth stack
construction.quarter_rule: (Q,d,j) -> (pi(S(j)),d,j), with a single globally shared pi chosen among 3! relabelings
construction.output_test: For each of three fixed planes, exactly one dash in each physical 3x3 column
construction.selection_caveat: Coordinate relabelings and the output-one-dash rule were tested retrospectively and depend on shared primary column assumptions. Do not interpret candidate multiplicities as posterior probabilities.

nine_frame_erasure_caveat.meaning: Retrospective conditional recovery, not independently calibrated holdout accuracy.

protocol: Inspect physical symbol only after committing both frozen competing forecasts. New evidence can falsify one of these tightly specified conditional families without endorsing the other or proving three-dimensional intended design.
